cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
MAX=(1<<62)-1
random.seed(5)
for trial in range(200):
 ev=[{'keys':['A']}];received=random.choice([None,0,5,20]);last=received;seen=set() if received is None else {received};current=0;epochs={} if received is None else {0:[received,received,1]};exp=[];closed=False
 for i in range(40):
  pn=random.randrange(0,80);ann=random.choice([None,0,1,2,3,4]);phase=random.randrange(2);ev.append(datagram(envelope('A',pn,b'\x01',width=4,phase=phase),(ann,)))
  ep=None
  if closed: st='CLOSED'
  elif ann is None:st='AUTH'
  else:
   window=ann==current or(current>0 and ann==current-1)or(current<MAX and ann==current+1)
   if not window or (ann&1)!=phase:st='AUTH'
   elif pn in seen:st='DUPLICATE';ep=ann
   else:
    bad=False
    for e,(mn,mx,c) in epochs.items():
     if e<ann and mx>=pn:bad=True
     elif e>ann and mn<=pn:bad=True
    if bad:st='KEY_UPDATE_ERROR';ep=ann;closed=True
    else:
     st='OK';ep=ann;seen.add(pn)
     if last is None or pn>last:last=pn
     if ann in epochs:
      mn,mx,c=epochs[ann];epochs[ann]=[min(mn,pn),max(mx,pn),c+1]
     else:epochs[ann]=[pn,pn,1]
     if ann==current+1 and current<MAX:current=ann
  exp.append((st,ep,pn))
 r=run(trace(ev,received={'I':None,'H':None,'A':received},local_cids=('aa','bb')))['traces'][0]
 got=[(p['status'],p['epoch'],p['pn']) for p in r['packets']]
 if got!=exp or r['key_epoch']!=current or r['received']['A']!=last:
  print('MISMATCH',trial,received)
  for j,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(got,exp)):
   if a!=b:print(j,a,b);break
  print(r['key_epoch'],current,r['received']['A'],last);break
else:print('all 200 match')
